2350.translation: For reasoning-error question, first check wetin dem dey criticize. If you check whether na di claim itself or something else, you go narrow di kind of error.

2351.translation: Check whether di speaker discuss di content of Lena recycling proposal or use another fact about Lena as di reason.

2352.translation: Di answer na makes. 'make a case for' na fixed collocation wey mean 'present argument to support something', so e fit when di report dey argue with evidence. does na general verb wey no pair with 'a case for', so e sound awkward.

2353.translation: Learn verb-noun combinations (collocations) as pairs, no be meaning alone. Remember di verb wey go with a case.

2354.translation: Compare di verbs wey normally pair with case when di report dey present argument.

2355.translation: Di answer na Organized a school recycling campaign that collected 300 kilograms of paper. E start with verb and show wetin you do with numerical result. Helped with various things ... no explain wetin you do.

2356.translation: Resume dey show achievements clearly and briefly. Avoid vague expressions.

2357.translation: Compare whether each option name specific activity or only give personal opinion or vague description.

2358.translation: Di answer na Although the museum was crowded, we stayed for three hours. Na contrast: plenty people dey but we stay long, so Although fit. So we left after a short time contradict say dem stay long.

2359.translation: When you dey join two sentences, first decide di connection between di facts: cause, contrast or time.

2360.translation: Think whether di crowded museum and di three-hour stay follow wetin person normally expect or contrast with am.

2361.translation: Di answer na The students who joined the club met every Friday. Di subject The students get main verb met. Di option wey start with Because na subordinate clause wey no get di main result clause, so e no complete.

2362.translation: Complete sentence get subject and main verb and complete meaning. No let relative clauses, conjunction clauses or -ing phrases confuse you.

2363.translation: For each option, find di main verb of di main clause (di verb wey get tense). Set aside di part after who or because.

2364.translation: Di answer na opinion letter to di school board. For persuasion, opinion writing wey give reasons fit. Diary entry na personal record, no be writing to persuade school board.

2365.translation: Di writing purpose (persuade, inform or record) and di readers dey determine di kind of writing.

2366.translation: Think who di writing address and wetin e dey request, then find di writing form wey fit that purpose.

2367.translation: For editing stage, you dey find and correct grammar, spelling and punctuation errors for finished writing. Gathering ideas belong to brainstorming (prewriting), so e different from editing.

2368.translation: Writing stages get order. Remember wetin happen for planning, drafting, revising and editing, then choose di description wey fit editing.

2369.translation: Editing dey happen when di writing almost complete. Separate di options into things wey happen before writing and things wey polish finished writing.

2370.translation: Which one be di small letter for capital letter B?

2411.translation:
Read di passage and choose wetin happen first.

"First, Mina wakes up at seven. Then she brushes her teeth. Next, she eats breakfast. Finally, she goes to school."

2412.translation: Find words wey show order, like First, Then, Next and Finally.

2413.translation: Wetin di sentence with First talk about happen first.

2414.translation: “wakes up at seven” follow First for di passage, so na im happen first.

2415.translation:
Read di passage and choose wetin happen last.

"First, Mina wakes up at seven. Then she brushes her teeth. Next, she eats breakfast. Finally, she goes to school."

2416.translation: Wetin di sentence with Finally talk about happen last.

2417.translation: “goes to school” follow Finally for di passage, so na im happen last.

2418.translation:
Read di passage and choose wetin happen immediately after 'mixes them in a bowl'.

"First, Jun takes out the flour and eggs. Then he mixes them in a bowl. Next, he bakes the cake in the oven. Finally, he puts cream on the cake."

2419.translation: First find di sentence for di passage wey get “mixes them in a bowl”.

2420.translation: Then check wetin happen for di very next sentence.

2421.translation: Immediately after “mixes them in a bowl”, di passage talk “bakes the cake in the oven”.

2422.translation:
Read di passage and choose wetin happen first.

"First, Jun takes out the flour and eggs. Then he mixes them in a bowl. Next, he bakes the cake in the oven. Finally, he puts cream on the cake."

"Sam went to the park after lunch. First, he played soccer with his friends. After that, he rode his bike. Finally, he drank some water and went home."

"First, Jun takes out the flour and eggs. Then he mixes them in a bowl. Next, he bakes the cake in the oven. Finally, he puts cream on the cake."

2442.translation:
Choose di sentence wey summarize di passage best.

"Many people throw away bottles and cans every day. When we recycle them, factories can make new products without using as many natural resources. Recycling also reduces the amount of trash in landfills."

2443.translation: Find di main idea wey di whole passage dey return to.

2444.translation: Sentence about only one detail, or something wey no dey for di passage, no be good summary.

2445.translation: “Recycling saves resources and reduces trash.” cover di main idea of di whole passage, so na di best summary.

2446.translation:
Choose di sentence wey summarize di passage best.

"Teenagers need about nine hours of sleep each night. Without enough sleep, students find it hard to focus in class and often feel tired. Going to bed at the same time every day can help."

2447.translation: “Teenagers need enough sleep to feel and study well.” cover di main idea of di whole passage, so na di best summary.

2448.translation:
Choose di sentence wey summarize di passage best.

"Honeybees visit flowers to collect nectar. While they move from flower to flower, pollen sticks to their bodies and falls onto other flowers. This helps plants grow fruits and seeds."

2449.translation: “Honeybees help plants grow by carrying pollen.” cover di main idea of di whole passage, so na di best summary.

2450.translation:
Choose di sentence wey summarize di passage best.

"The new city library opened last month. It has a quiet reading room, a children's corner, and free computers. Many families visit it on weekends."

2451.translation: “The new library offers useful spaces for many people.” cover di main idea of di whole passage, so na di best summary.

2452.translation:
Choose di sentence wey summarize di passage best.

"Last Saturday, our class cleaned the beach near our school. We picked up plastic bags, bottles, and old nets. After three hours, the beach looked clean again, and we felt proud."

2453.translation: “Our class cleaned the beach and felt proud.” cover di main idea of di whole passage, so na di best summary.
